import subprocess, os, sys, glob, shutil

path = "budget.xlsx"
if not os.path.exists(path):
    print("ERROR: budget.xlsx not found")
    sys.exit(1)

outdir = "csv_out"
if os.path.exists(outdir):
    shutil.rmtree(outdir)
os.makedirs(outdir, exist_ok=True)

cmd = ["soffice", "--headless", "--norestore", "--convert-to", "csv", "--outdir", outdir, path]
try:
    r = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=120)
    print("returncode:", r.returncode)
    print("stdout:", r.stdout[-2000:])
    print("stderr:", r.stderr[-2000:])
except FileNotFoundError:
    print("ERROR: soffice not found")
    sys.exit(1)
except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
    print("ERROR: soffice timed out")
    sys.exit(1)

files = sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(outdir, "*")))
print("Files produced:", files)
for f in files:
    print(f"\n===== {f} =====")
    with open(f, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as fh:
        for i, line in enumerate(fh):
            print(f"[{i}] {line.rstrip()}")

import zipfile, re, sys, os

path = "budget.xlsx"
if not os.path.exists(path):

    sys.exit(1)

z = zipfile.ZipFile(path)
print("=== ZIP CONTENTS ===")
for n in z.namelist():
    print(" ", n)

NS = "{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main}"
RNS = "{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships}"

# workbook.xml -> sheets
wbxml = z.read("xl/workbook.xml").decode("utf-8")
print("\n=== workbook.xml (first 2000 chars) ===")
print(wbxml[:2000])

# rels
try:
    rels = z.read("xl/_rels/workbook.xml.rels").decode("utf-8")
except KeyError:
    rels = ""
print("\n=== workbook.xml.rels ===")
print(rels[:2000])

# shared strings
if "xl/sharedStrings.xml" in z.namelist():
    ss = z.read("xl/sharedStrings.xml").decode("utf-8")
    print("\n=== sharedStrings.xml (first 2000 chars) ===")
    print(ss[:2000])
